node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) cofactor-16 once-divided exclusion
node.closure: exact support branch, square-norm contraction, dual radius census, and certified norm intervals
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 16 is impossible when the six-singleton support lies in one parity class but not one residue class modulo four. A complete 9080-orbit once-divided atlas, an exact square-norm contraction, and dual complete radius engines place all 1816625504 product-live vectors outside the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT BRANCH EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: forward triple/sign and reverse sign/triple engines agree orbit by orbit on 73175732492 unique radius triples, 585405859936 exact sign tests, 1816625308 below-window vectors, 196 above-window vectors, and zero unresolved. Only the 39936 primitive m16 support orbits remain open.
